title: DC fusion center FOIA on psychotronic effects
summary: Dave Rossi tells of DC fusion center FOIA on psychotronic effects, about undated at Washington, D.C., and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there was a FOIA leak out of the Washington D.C. fusion center that someone had filed a FOIA with regards to looking into some uh political groups, but it turned out that they were given I think the file was called uh effects on the human body.

plain: A researcher named Dave Rossi, speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast, describes a records request made to the Washington D.C. fusion center, a hub where government agencies share security information. He says someone used FOIA, a US law that lets anyone request government records, to ask about certain political groups, and instead got back a file he recalls was titled "effects on the human body." Rossi tells it as a sign that officials have looked at devices said to affect the body and mind, sometimes called psychotronic effects.
